title: Enrolment 搜尋 + 批次工具列
content:
Admin Enrolments 頁面目前僅有 status filter tabs + pagination。缺少文字搜尋與批次操作。

功能需求：
1. 搜尋欄：依 enrollee name / email / idDocNumber 過濾（API query param: ?search=）
2. 日期範圍過濾：startDate / endDate query params
3. 批次選取：checkbox 欄位 + 全選 header checkbox
4. 批次工具列：選取後顯示「Batch Approve」「Batch Reject」按鈕（顯示選取數量）
5. i18n 支援

注意：批次 Approve/Reject 可沿用現有 groupId 機制或新增 batch endpoint。
acceptance: Search bar filters enrolments by name/email/idDocNumber (server-side)
Date range picker filters by submittedAt range
Each row has a checkbox; header checkbox selects/deselects all on current page
Batch Approve button appears when ≥1 selected, shows confirmation dialog
Batch Reject button appears when ≥1 selected, shows rejection dialog
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
files: src/app/[locale]/admin/enrolments/page.tsx (refactor — add search bar, date picker, checkboxes, batch toolbar)
src/dictionaries/types.ts (update — add search/batch keys to AdminDict)
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && search by name/email/idDocNumber works, date filter works, batch approve/reject works.
